source.name: Most frequent words: Russian (wordfreq, English Wiktionary)
source.notes:
The 6,000 most frequent Russian words, in frequency order.
Frequency: wordfreq 3.1 "large" list (rspeer/wordfreq; data CC BY-SA 4.0), which combines Wikipedia, OpenSubtitles, news, Google Books and Twitter.
Lemmatization: OpenRussian.org inflection tables (Badestrand/russian-dictionary, CC BY-SA 4.0) plus Wiktionary headwords
Disambiguation: UD Russian SynTagRus treebank (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), used only to split ambiguous forms such as уже (already, or narrower); none of its text is included
Definitions and parts of speech: English Wiktionary, via the Wiktextract/Kaikki.org extraction in Vuizur/Wiktionary-Dictionaries (2022–23 snapshot; CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL)
Stress marks, gender, aspect and inflection tables: OpenRussian.org (Badestrand/russian-dictionary, CC BY-SA 4.0).
Declension tables: OpenRussian.org (Badestrand/russian-dictionary, CC BY-SA 4.0) for nouns and adjectives, with stress; pronouns and numerals from the forms annotated in the UD SynTagRus treebank (annotations only, no text; unstressed).
Example sentences: Tatoeba (CC-BY-2.0-FR); UD Russian Taiga (CC-BY-SA-4.0); UD Russian GSD (CC-BY-SA-4.0); UD Russian SynTagRus (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, non-commercial use only); AI-written (Claude) (AI-generated, not checked by a native speaker); the source of every sentence is listed in ru-sentence-credits.tsv.
See docs/VOCABULARY_SOURCES.md for licences and attribution.
